integrity: The arbitrary-order proof is symbolic and uses only the extraspecial commutator form plus a counting argument on an orthogonal subspace. Exhaustive finite computations are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to extraspecial p-groups.
No claim is made for general class-two p-groups with degenerate commutator form or larger center.
The directly relevant 2005 extraspecial source was inspected through its publisher abstract and bibliographic record rather than full readable text.
title: Three domination parameters of extraspecial noncommuting graphs
